tagline: Specialty coffee, handcrafted seasonal sips, and housemade pastries in West New York.
address: 158 61st St, West New York, NJ 07093, USA

auditNotes: The current landing page relies on an ultra-minimalist single yellow box layout that forces guests to tap through separate external links rather than immediately previewing popular signature drinks or baked goods.
Mobile visitors lack an instant tap-to-directions button or an interactive seasonal menu showcase, leading to lost takeout and morning commuter traffic.

services.name: Ceremonial Matcha Latte

services.name: Gourmet Toasted Grilled Cheese
services.description: Melted aged cheeses and savory spreads pressed golden on artisanal bakery sourdough.

reviews.author: Harper Meehan
reviews.text:
Stumbled upon this cafe while we were visiting for a few days. We tried the Rosemary Maple latte, cinnamon maple latte, grilled cheese, chia seed pudding and banana bread. This was the BEST banana bread I have ever had.

This cafe is locally and family owned.

reviews.author: Gabe Raybould
reviews.text: Malpa Cafe is the best!! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it the perfect place to slow down, enjoy a coffee, and have something delicious to eat. You can the owners put a heavy emphasis on quality ingredients when it comes to the coffee and the food
